miniProject.title: Learned dynamics with honest planning attribution
miniProject.brief: Extend `policylab` with an `mbrl/` laboratory: fitted dynamics, ensembles, short-horizon rollouts and search planners over small systems. Prove the planner on a known-dynamics oracle before trusting any learned model. Attribute every win to model, planner or budget with matched model-free controls.
steps: Prove the planner first on a known-dynamics sanity case in `mbrl/`: one-step prediction tests, open-loop against closed-loop replanning, random shooting versus CEM on equal model queries, and a simple-controller baseline as the ceiling.

Fit an ensemble of probabilistic dynamics models, check member disagreement away from data, derive the Gaussian loss it minimizes, and show one induced exploitation plan that scores well imagined but fails in the system, then contain it with an uncertainty penalty.

Run a data-aggregation loop that collects real transitions under the new policy and refits, showing error falling on the new distribution, and fix a fallback rule that shortens the horizon or hands back control past an uncertainty threshold.

Implement branched rollouts that start from real buffer states and run short model steps under the current policy with imagined and real updates accounted apart, then sweep the horizon and keep the point where model bias reverses the gain beside a matched model-free control.
Add latent-dynamics prediction tests on an encoded state at small scale, then implement tree search with its four steps and state the simulation budget behind every per-move decision.

Attribute results with swap experiments that isolate planner, model, reward and policy error, and run the matched model-free baseline with per-run records and failures kept, stating the operating range where the model earns its keep.
deliverables: `mbrl/` dynamics, ensembles and planners with oracle-first prediction and planning tests.
Horizon sweeps with the bias-reversal point, aggregation evidence and latent prediction tests.
Attribution table with matched model-free controls and per-run records including failures.

rubric.pass: Shooting and CEM match hand rollouts on the sanity case with equal queries, and the simple controller sets the ceiling.
rubric.strong: A planning-below-oracle result is diagnosed as a planner fault, never charged to the model.

rubric.pass: Ensemble disagreement grows away from data, and the exploitation plan shows an imagined-versus-real gap across seeds.
rubric.strong: The penalty contains the exploit on a rerun, with member diversity evidence ruling out single-seed agreement.

rubric.pass: Branched rollouts carry their branch starts, the sweep keeps the reversal point, and imagined updates never count as samples.
rubric.strong: Aggregation lowers new-distribution error on refit, and the fallback rule fires on a demonstrated uncertain state.

rubric.pass: Swap experiments isolate each error source, and the matched baseline shares steps, compute, seeds and versions.
rubric.strong: Failed horizons stay in the report, and the operating range names where the model stops earning its keep.

miniProject.feedsInto: `mbrl/` models, planners and attribution evidence feed agent sandboxes, language-policy rollouts and the capstone.
